Balraj Sangar",designation:"S.E., HPSEBL",nominee:"Nominated expert from Outside Institute appointed by the board"}],secretary:{name:"Dr. Gaurav Tandon",designation:"Registrar",organization:"IIIT Una"}},Yn={name:"Prof. Manish Gaur",content:["Our Institute was established in the year 2014-15 as an Institute of National Importance under the MoE, GoI, by an IIIT (PPP) Act of Parliament No. 23 of 2017.","Dr Manish Gaur has recently joined as the Director of Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Una (Himachal Pradesh). He is a Professor in Computer Science at Institute of Engineering and Technology Lucknow (a constituent college of Dr APJ Abdul Kalam University Lucknow (AKTU)) and was serving as Pro Vice Chancellor of AKTU. He has also served as Adjunct Professor at IIT Jammu as well as Eminent Faculty at Rastriya Raksha University Gandhinagar, both are institutions of national importance.","His research area can be broadly classified as Formal Methods and Verification of Large Systems; Semantics of Concurrent Programming Languages. His recent work interest includes formal modelling of stochastic behaviour of processes in a distributed network and formal behavioural modeling of AI. Prof Gaur is an Honorary Research Fellow of University of Glasgow, UK. He obtained his doctorate degree in computer science from University of Sussex, UK; M.Tech. in Computer Sc. from IIT Delhi and Bachelor in Engineering from NIT, Surat (then SV Regional Engineering College Surat). Prof Gaur’s academic track has been extraordinary throughout. He is a recipient of Commonwealth Academic Fellowship in 2012 and Commonwealth Scholarship in 2005 from the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission UK. Dr Gaur was awarded the Young Scientist Award of Government of Uttar Pradesh in the Year 2003 for his contributions to the academics and research. His M.Tech. Project was awarded best project during the academic year 2001-02 at department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Delhi leading to the conferment of prestigious Suresh Chandra Memorial Award. All his publications are in widely acclaimed journals and conference proceedings.","Many research, consultancy and projects from reputed organizations such as Google, Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Commission (UPSSC), SERB- DST are in his credit. He has held various academic and administrative positions at the university. He has widely travelled both within India and abroad, primarily in Western Europe and Middle East, for various academic purposes such as invited talks, conferences, short courses and project collaborations.","He has worked as founder director of newly created institution, Center for Advanced Studies at AKTU from July 2017 to March 2021. The center has come up with state of art laboratories, post graduate academic programs in the fields of Cyber Security, Mechatronics, Nano Technology, Energy Sc and Technology and Manufacturing & Automation under his leadership. He has served as member of various statutory bodies of the university for long. His academic administrative acumen include policy and planning in the field of higher education. Prof Gaur has been contributing in the area for last 29 years."],email:"director[at]iiitu[dot]ac[dot]in"},VR=[{image:SR,title:"B.Tech",link:"/admissions/ug"},{image:kR,title:"M.Tech",link:"/admissions/pg"},{image:CR,title:"Ph.D",link:"/admissions/phd"}],GR=[{image:FR,name:"Dr. Naman Garg",responsibility:"Appellate Authority",phone:"+91 9555698585",email:"registrar[at]iiitu[dot]ac[dot]in",facultyEmail:"namangarg@iiitu.ac.in"},{image:"uploads/faculty/Dr. Gurpreet Kaurï»¿1727002625006-272478602.webp",name:"Dr. Gurpreet Kaur",responsibility:"Public Information Officer",phone:"+91 9878302080",email:"pio[at]iiitu[dot]ac[dot]in",facultyEmail:"gurpreetkaur@iiitu.ac.in"}],th=[{title:"IIIT Una Organization Chart",link:`${gt}/RTI/orgnization-chart.pdf`},{title:"IIIT Una vacant seats and No. of Dropouts",link:`${gt}/RTI/IIIT-Una-vacant-seats-and-No.-of-dropouts.pdf`},{title:"TP-Audited-Report-2023-24",link:`${gt}/RTI/Audit-Report-IIIT_Una-2023-24.pdf`},{title:"Research Status-AY 2023-24",link:`${gt}/RTI/Research-Status-AY-2023-24-Final.pdf`},{title:"IIIT Una Additional Responsibilities – Office Order",link:`${gt}/RTI/Additional-Responsibilities-Office-Order.pdf`},{title:"Salary Details",link:`${gt}/RTI/salary-details-.pdf`},{title:"RTI Proactive Disclosure us 4 of the RTI act",link:`${gt}/RTI/RTI-Proactive.pdf`}],YR={header:"IIIT Una is one of the 20 IIITs being setup, funded and managed by the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India under the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model. The partners setting up IIIT Una are the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, the Govt. of Himachal Pradesh, HP Power Corporation Limited and HP Transmission Corporation Limited. Admissions to the undergraduate programmes in the Institute are made through the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE)."},yi={about:"IIIT Una is one of the 20 IIITs being setup, funded and managed by the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India under the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model. The partners setting up IIIT Una are the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India, the Govt. of Himachal Pradesh, HP Power Corporation Limited and HP Transmission Corporation Limited. Admissions to the undergraduate programmes in the Institute are made through the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE). At present, IIIT Una operates from its permanent campus at Saloh, Una. The campus is fully furnished and working full fledged from its permanent campus.",vision:"To build a vibrant multicultural learning environment with value based academic principles and to achieve excellence in teaching and research and to contribute effectively and responsibly to the national and global community",mission:["To provide quality education to the students with practical orientation.","To collaborate with industries and research institutions to solve socially relevant problems.","To inspire students to become responsible citizens and competent professionals with ethical values."],history:"Our Institute was established in the year 2014-15 as an Institute of National Importance under the MoE, GoI, by an IIIT (PPP) Act of Parliament No. 23 of 2017.As the Master Plan was prepared without the user requirement specification from the Institute, the approval of the Master Plan was deferred. Then the architects prepared the Master Plan based on the user requirement specification given by the Institute and got approved.The CPWD prepared the Notice Inviting Tenders and published in the month of September 2019. The deadline for Tenders have been October 2019 and the award was finalized in the month of December 2019. The contractor mobilized the machinery, material, and manpower for commencing the construction work. The Bhoomi Pooja was performed in the month of January 2020 with the expected completion time of 14 months.But unfortunately, when the earth was excavated water came up due to its water table at a depth of 2 meters. So, the foundation has to be changed and the architects have to rework the structural design which took two months time.The CoVID-19 pandemic struck the whole nation and IIIT Una was also not an exception. The work got delayed due to the first and second waves by about six months.On 15, August 2021, the celebration of Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav began in the Permanent Campus by hoisting the National Flag on a 75 feet flag mast. This event marked the very first event in the Permanent Campus.On 28, October 2021 the NIT Hamirpur Transit Campus was vacated and shifted to the Permanent Campus. From 29, October 2021 onwards the Institute started its functioning from the permanent campus in a record time of 03 years and four months since the joining of the Founder Director.Thereafter the fourth semester in-person classes were commenced on 14, Mar.22, followed by the commencement of II semester classes on 09, May 22. The classes for VII and V semester were commenced on 18, July 22.",statutes:WR,act:UR},XR=[{src:ER},{src:PR},{src:TR},{src:DR},{src:OR},{src:MR},{src:AR},{src:IR},{src:LR},{src:RR}],rc={mentors:[{name:"Dr. Shatrughan Modi",image:"/DevTeam/Dr.Shatrughan He emphasized the need of such social cell for educational institutions. He encouraged everyone to embrace the concept of PSR - Personal Social Responsibility- for one's emotional growth and spreading goodness in the society.",image:"",caption:"",subCaption:""},{heading:"Objectives",body:"To make students learn about the need of personal social responsibility towards community and environment.
